'''Jaemus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with [[Galentro Heavy Works]] [[Jaemus shipyards|shipyards]] comparable in size to [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was the headquarters of [[Renikco]], a front used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jesco Comark]]. At the shipyards, Renikco and [[Santhe Corporation/Legends|Santhe]] employed modified [[Sector Plexus/Legends|Sector Plexus]] [[Tech 4 PDV|courier droids]] as transports for his [[Death-Hunter Cyborg]] assassins. The Death-Hunters themselves were created from [[Human/Legends|Human]] subjects taken from neighboring [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]].<ref name="AJ9" />

Jesco's daughter, [[Amber Comark]], exposed the [[Operation Death-Hunter|Death-Hunter project]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] ordered [[Dursa Conegan]] to put together a team to investigate.<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet came under the control of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. The shipyards of Jaemus were subcontracted by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] to produce the [[Enforcer-class picket cruiser|''Enforcer''-class picket cruiser]], a versatile ship based on the hull of the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]], for the Alignment.<ref name="TEA" /> Sienar had a large testing range at Jaemus to evaluate new ship designs.<ref name="AJ3">{{JournalCite|3|The Pentastar Alignment}}</ref>
